_meta.note: THE single source of truth for delivery rates. Everything else is generated from this file by tools/sync-delivery-copy.py — the frontend ZONES constant, the checkout radios, the Shipping & Returns table, and the announcement bar. Change a rate HERE, then run the tool.
_meta.why: These three numbers were previously written in five places: api.js, the PHP seeder, the shipping page, the checkout radios, and the announcement bar on all 24 pages. Changing a rate meant finding all five, and the first one missed becomes a promise the site does not keep.
